title: Elementor Pro & WooCommerce Builder — Design-Driven, Detail-Obsessed (Long-Term, Full-Time)
description:
We are a Swiss performance marketing agency serving French-speaking businesses (SMEs). We build high-converting websites, landing pages, and e-commerce stores — not templates, not cookie-cutter sites. Every project must look custom, feel premium, and convert.



We're looking for a key tea
mber to own the web delivery process: from wireframe to finished site. You will receive brand direction and conversion goals. Your job is to turn that into a pixel-perfect, mobile-first website — design, copy, and build — that looks and performs at a premium level.



This is not a job for someone who drags and drops Starter Templates and calls it done.



This is a full-time, dedicated position. We are NOT looking for freelancers, part-timers, or project-based workers. You work exclusively with us — no side clients, no splitting your time. If you're looking for a gig or a side project, this is not it.



If you currently work for another employer or agency — do not apply. We need someone 100% available and 100% committed from day one. This is not a "second job."





What You'll Build



Business websites (5–30 pages) with strong visual hierarchy and conversion architecture

Landing pages optimized for Google Ads and Meta Ads traffic

WooCommerce stores with product catalogs, filtering, custom single/archive templates

Elementor Pro templates with dynamic content, custom loops, and clean responsive design

Speed-optimized pages (Core Web Vitals green across the board)



All client-facing content is in French. You don't need to be a native speaker — you can use AI tools to assist. But you MUST understand three disciplines:



Copywriting — You know what makes a headline work, how to stack benefits, how to handle objections in text, and how to write a CTA that earns the click. You can write hero sections, subheads, body text, and product descriptions that sell.



Design — You understand visual hierarchy, whitespace, typography, contrast, and layout patterns. You build pages that guide the eye and feel intentional on every device.



Conversion & CRO — You know WHY elements are placed where they are. Above the fold, trust signals, social proof, urgency — you think in terms of what makes a visitor take action, not just what looks nice.



If you don't understand all three, this role is not for you — please don't apply. You don't need to be an expert in everything, but you need to get how these work together and be willing to sharpen your skills using AI tools every single day.



French copy must read naturally — AI-assisted is fine, but the output must feel like a native wrote it. We review, we give feedback, we refine together. But you bring the first draft, not us.





Hard Requirements (Non-Negotiable)



You must have minimum 3–5 years of proven, professional experience and demonstrated portfolio results in ALL of the following:



Elementor Pro — Advanced. Custom widgets, theme builder (header/footer/single/archive), motion effects, custom CSS, responsive editing across all breakpoints. Not just "I know Elementor."



WooCommerce — Full store builds. Product setup, variable products, category architecture, custom templates for shop/single/archive, payment gateway integration, shipping configuration.



Visual Design & Layout Hierarchy — You understand whitespace, typography pairing, visual weight, F-pattern/Z-pattern scanning, CTA placement, contrast ratios. You can look at a design and KNOW what's wrong before being told.



CSS & Light PHP — You can write custom CSS without Googling every property. You can modify a 
p snippet. You understand child themes.



Page Speed Optimization — Image optimization (WebP/AVIF), lazy loading, font optimization, plugin audit, caching configuration. You know what render-blocking means and how to fix it.



Mobile-First Responsive Design — Not "it works on mobile." It must LOOK intentional on mobile. Custom breakpoint adjustments, touch-friendly UI, no horizontal scrolling, no overlapping elements.



SEO Fundamentals — Proper heading hierarchy (H1?H2?H3), alt tags, internal linking structure, schema markup awareness, clean URL structure.



AI-Powered Workflow — You actively use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar) to accelerate your work: drafting copy, generating layouts, debugging code, optimizing images, researching competitors. You don't just "know about AI" — you use it daily and it makes you faster. If you're still doing everything manually, you're too slow for this role.



GA4 & Tracking Integration — You can set up Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, and event configuration. You understand how pixels work (Meta, Google Ads), how to verify they fire correctly, and how to debug tracking issues.





Strong Plus (Not Required, But Will Set You Apart)



Figma ? Elementor conversion experience

Experience with booking/appointment plugins

Experience with multilingual setups (WPML or Polylang)

Cloudflare configuration basics





What We Provide



Brand direction, conversion goals, and target audience briefs for each project

Reference designs or competitor examples when relevant

Review and feedback on your copy and design before delivery

A proprietary Elementor workflow plugin that accelerates your build process

Direct Slack/Telegram communication — no micromanagement, no pointless meetings

Long-term stability — this is not a project gig, this is a partnership





What We Expect



Pixel-perfect execution. If something is 3px off, you notice it before we do.

Proactive communication. If something is unclear, you ask BEFORE building the wrong thing.

Speed without sloppiness. A standard business website (8–12 pages) should take you 5–7 working days from brief to delivery, not 3 weeks.

Ownership. You don't wait to be told what to do next. You see what needs fixing and you fix it.





Technical Setup Requirements



Stable internet connection: minimum 25 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload (we will verify via speed test)

Laptop or desktop capable of running Elementor Pro, Chrome DevTools, and multiple tabs without lag (minimum 8GB RAM, SSD)

Backup power solution (UPS or generator) — if your power goes out mid-project, you must be able to continue or communicate immediately

Backup internet (mobile hotspot or secondary connection)

Quiet workspace for video calls





Compensation & Growth Path



Starting rate: $600–$750/month USD depending on proven skill level.



Clear salary milestones based on performance, not time:

Start: $600–$750/month

6 months (KPIs met): $900–$1,000/month

12 months (consistent performance): $1,200+/month + project bonuses



We also offer project-based bonuses for fast, high-quality delivery.



After 3 months: 10 paid vacation days per year (2 weeks — aligned with European standards). Philippine public holidays observed.



Paid via Wise or PayPal. Full-time (40 hrs/week), flexible schedule within reason. We care about output, not clock-watching. But you must be available for real-time communication during at least 4 overlapping hours with Central European Time (CET).



We're not looking for someone chasing the highest paycheck today. We're looking for someone hungry, skilled, and ready to grow into a Design & Build Project Manager role as the agency scales — leading projects, managing timelines, and owning client delivery end to end.





First 30 Days — What Success Looks Like



These are the expectations for your first month. If you meet them, you're in the right place. If not, we part ways — no hard feelings, but no second chances.



Deliver your first complete website (8–12 pages) within 7 working days of receiving the brief

Respond to messages within 2 hours during overlapping CET hours

Deliver mobile-responsive pages that require zero revision on responsiveness

Demonstrate autonomous problem-solving: research, d
, build — then ask for review, not instructions

Show you can write French copy that needs minor corrections, not rewrites





Confidentiality & NDA



You will have access to proprietary tools, client data, internal processes, and agency strategies. Before starting, you will sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement.



This is non-negotiable. Everything you see, build, or learn inside this agency stays inside this agency. Sharing client information, internal tools, workflows, or strategies with anyone — including other employers or clients — is grounds for immediate termination.





Terms



2-week notice period from either side

All work produced during employment is the property of the agency

All client access (WordPress, hosting, tools) will be revoked upon termination

If performance expectations are not met within the first 30 days, employment ends immediately with payment for days worked





HOW TO APPLY — FOLLOW THESE STEPS EXACTLY



Applications that don't follow ALL steps below will be automatically rejected.



Step 1 — Subject Line

Your message subject must be exactly:

"BUILDER-2026 — [Your First Name]"

Any other subject line = instant reject.



Step 2 — Portfolio

Send links to your 3 best websites — the ones that make you proud. The work you'd show if you had 30 seconds to prove you're the real deal. Not 10 links, not "here's everything I've done." Your top 3.



These must be sites YOU built entirely on your own — design, build, and content placement. Not sites where you "participated," "contributed," or "helped the team." If you didn't own it from start to finish, don't include it.



For each one, include:

The URL

One sentence on what the client's business does

One sentence on what YOU built end to end

Whether the site is mobile-optimized (we will check)



Do NOT send Behance/Dribbble mockups. We want live, functioning websites.



Step 3 — Availability

State your earliest possible start date and whether you currently have other clients or employers.





What Happens Next



We review applications (expect 48–72 hours)

Shortlisted candidates get a video call

Selected candidate starts immediately on real client projects



Do not apply if you plan to outsource our work to someone else. We will find out, and we will terminate immediately. We are hiring YOU, not your team.

description:
We're an Australian MSP building serious AI automation into how we (and our clients) run. We already run a self-hosted n8n instance, an AI gateway (OpenClaw), LibreChat, and local LLMs on a Mac Studio. We're looking for someone who genuinely loves this stuff and wants to build real automations end-to-end — not just follow a tutorial once.



If you spend your weekends wiring up agents, breaking APIs, and getting AI to do boring work for you, keep reading.



What you'll be doing





Designing and building automations in n8n (multi-step workflows, error handling, webhooks, custom logic)

Connecting LLMs (Claude, OpenAI, OpenRouter) into real workflows via our AI gateway

Building and refining AI agents to handle support, admin, reconciliation and reporting tasks

Integrating apps and APIs — Xero, Microsoft 365, NinjaOne, HaloPSA and others

Writing clean prompts and agent instructions that actually work reliably

Documenting what you build so the rest of the team can use it





What we're looking for





Strong hands-on experience with n8n (or Make/Zapier, but n8n is what we use)

Comfortable with LLM APIs and prompt engineering

Some scripting ability (Python or JavaScript) — enough to write custom functions and parse JSON

Understands webhooks, REST APIs and authentication

Excellent written English and clear spoken English

Reliable, self-managing, and genuinely curious about AI







HOW TO APPLY — please read carefully (this is part of the test)



Applications that skip any of these steps will not be considered. We're looking for people who follow instructions and pay attention to detail.



1. Resume / CV — attach it or link it.



2. A short voice recording (1–2 minutes). Record yourself (phone is fine — use a free tool like 
) answering:





Your name and where you're based

The most impressive automation or AI agent you've personally built — what it did and what tools you used

Why this role interests you





3. Answer the 5 questions below. For each one, rate yourself 1–10 and add one sentence explaining your rating. Be honest — a confident "6 with good reasoning" beats an inflated "10".

Q1. Building automations in n8n (multi-step workflows, error handling, custom nodes, self-hosted setups). Rating: __/10 — why?



Q2. Working with LLM APIs (Claude / Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter) — calling them, handling responses, managing tokens/cost. Rating: __/10 — why?

GLOWE Clean is a fast-growing residential cleaning company serving busy families in California. We get a steady flow of inbound leads from online ads and need someone who can respond instantly, build rapport, and book appointments — so our founder can focus on growing the business.



This is a **long-term role** for someone who wants stability, responsibility, and the chance to grow with the company.



---



## The Role



You'll be the founder's **Personal Assistant + Lead Response Specialist**.



**Your #1 job:** Respond to new leads within 1 minute, warm them up via text (and occasional calls), and book them into our calendar.



You don't need to hard sell. You're the friendly first contact, not the closer.



We need someone who can cover a wide daily availability window (up to ~16 hours) using their phone and laptop. You won't be working nonstop — but you must stay alert to lead notifications and respond fast during your shift.



---



## Responsibilities



**Lead response & nurture**

- Monitor inbound leads (SMS / WhatsApp / CRM) during your shift

- Respond to **100% of new leads within 1 minute**

- Start friendly text conversations, ask simple qualifying questions (location, home size, timing, budget) using our scripts

- Make short warm-up calls when needed (no closing, no pricing negotiations)

- Book qualified leads into the founder's calendar

- Send reminders, confirmations, and follow-ups to reduce no-shows

- Run simple outbound follow-ups to older leads using our templates



**Personal assistant / admin**

- Manage the founder's calendar

- Keep our CRM (GoHighLevel) organized: tags, notes, pipeline stages

- Light inbox triage: flag important messages, archive the rest

- Simple admin tasks (spreadsheets, checklists, documenting processes)



---



## Schedule & Availability



- You won't be actively working every minute, but you must:

- Cover a long daily window (up to ~14 hours) aligned with US Pacific Time — for example, **5 AM – 8 PM PT** (which is **10 PM – 2 PM PHT the next day**)

- You won't be actively working every minute, but you must:

  - Keep notifications on

  - Respond to new leads within 1 minute

  - Have daily focused blocks for follow-ups, admin, and calendar work

- Exact hours and breaks will be finalized together



?? **Important:** this is a graveyard shift role. Most of your work will fall during Philippine nighttime hours. Please only apply if you're comfortable working a night schedule long-term.



---



## Requirements



- Based in the **Philippines**

- Excellent written and spoken English — clear, friendly, professional

- Fast, reliable internet (fiber preferred) + smartphone for instant notifications

- Backup power and/or backup internet (brownout-ready)

- Comfortable texting and calling US homeowners

- Highly responsive, organized, detail-oriented

- **Plus:** BPO, real estate VA, or appointment-setting experience strongly preferred (OnlineJobs.ph, Upwork, or agency background all welcome)



---



## What Success Looks Like (after 30-day ramp-up)



- Responding to 100% of new leads within 1 minute during your shift

- Running daily follow-ups on all open leads

- Consistently booking qualified appointments for the founder

- Calendar and CRM stay clean, accurate, and up to date

- Proactively reminding the founder of key tasks and appointments



Strong performance = pay raises and bonuses tied to booked jobs and retention.



---



## Compensation



- **USD $800/month**

- Full-time, long-term

- Paid monthly via Wise, PayPal, or similar (mutually agreed)

- 13th month consideration after 1 year of strong performance



---



## How to Apply



Please send the following:



**1. Short intro (1–2 paragraphs)**

- Your city/province in the Philippines

- Your experience with customer communication, appointment setting, or executive assistance

- Confirmation that you can work US Pacific Time hours (graveyard shift) long-term



**2. A 2 minute Loom video** (required) where you:

- Introduce yourself and your background

- Explain why you're a good fit for a fast-response, long-availability role on a night shift

- Read this sample message out loud as if texting a new lead:



> *"Hey Sarah, this is [Your Name] from GLOWE Clean. Thanks for reaching out! I'd love to help you get a quote. First, can you tell me your city, how many bedrooms and bathrooms you have, and how soon you'd like your home cleaned?"*



**3. Include the word "LIME"** somewhere in your message so we know you read the full post.

- Design and build high-converting landing pages and funnels in GoHighLevel and ClickFunnels, optimized for desktop and mobile

- Use Figma to wireframe, prototype, and finalize pixel-perfect designs

- Design scroll-stopping static ads for Meta

- Figma expert, fast and efficient, with deep hands-on experience

- You've actually built pages in GoHighLevel and/or ClickFunnels, not just designed for them

- You know what makes a static ad convert

- Sharp eye for sleek, modern, conversion-focused design

- Available during US business hours



The style we build



Here are real funnels in the style and at the level you'd be building. Use them to get a feel for what we do:

We're keeping this simple. Send us a Figma link with your design work:

on't worry about the copy, that's something we handle, so feel free to use AI to fill it in.

title: High-Retention YouTube Video Editor for Outdoor / Hunting Channel
description:
I am looking for an excellent YouTube video editor for an outdoor, hunting, survival, and precision shooting channel.



I will provide the footage, thumbnails, titles, and AI video clips when needed. Your job is to turn the raw footage into a highly engaging, fast-paced, professional YouTube video that keeps viewers watching.



This is not basic editing. I need someone who understands YouTube retention editing, fast pacing, storytelling, jump cuts, captions, sound design, and pattern interrupts.



Main Responsibilities:



You will edit long-form YouTube videos using footage such as:



Outdoor hunting footage

Scope-cam footage

Reenactment footage

Talking-head clips

B-roll

AI-generated clips that I provide

Voiceover

Natural audio

Music and sound effects

You must be able to create a clean story sequence, such as:



Strong hook in the first 3 seconds

Fast setup

Outdoor/scouting footage

Reenactment angle

Scope-cam footage

Reaction shot

Explanation

Lesson learned

Call to action

Introduction / Retention Hook Requirements (Very Important):



The first 30–60 seconds of every video are critical. I want intros inspired by high-retention outdoor creators such as Outdoor Boys, where viewers immediately feel that something exciting, surprising, or high-stakes is about to happen.



The intro should use the best 
nts from the video as teasers before the main story begins, including:



Quick flashes of the biggest payoff 
nts

Scope-cam highlights

Close calls, reactions, or unexpected 
nts

Cinematic outdoor shots

Strong sound design and music builds

Fast pacing with curiosity-driven editing

The goal is to make viewers think: “I need to see how this turns out.”



You should be able to build a compelling cold open that increases audience retention before transitioning smoothly into the main story.



Editing Style I Want:



I want a very high-retention YouTube editing style where something visually changes every 3–7 seconds to keep the viewer engaged.



This can include:



Jump cuts

Punch-ins / zoom cuts

B-roll

Captions

Sound effects

Music changes

Camera angle changes

Text overlays

Motion graphics

Quick visual resets

Pattern interrupts

Cutting dead space aggressively

The video should feel fast, clean, cinematic, and addictive — but not childish or sloppy.



Very Important: Best-Take Editing



Sometimes I record in one long take and repeat the same sentence multiple times until I say it correctly.



You must be able to:



Remove rambling

Remove awkward pauses

Remove bad takes

Remove repeated sentences

Remove filler words when needed

Choose the best version of each sentence

Make the final video sound natural and smooth

I need someone who can turn messy raw footage into a sharp final video.



Short-Form Editing:



You may also be asked to create short clips for:



YouTube Shorts

TikTok

Instagram Reels

 Reels

Shorts should have:



Strong hook in the first 1 second

Fast cuts

Captions

Zooms

Sound effects

Clear payoff

Loopable ending when possible

Software Experience Preferred:



Please apply if you are skilled with one or more of these:



Adobe Premiere Pro

DaVinci Resolve

CapCut

Final Cut Pro

Descript

Gling

FireCut

After Effects is a plus

You do not need to create thumbnails.

You do not need to create AI videos.

You do not need to write the scripts.



Your main job is excellent video editing and retention.



Required Skills:



Excellent YouTube video editing ability

Strong pacing

Strong storytelling

Good English comprehension

Ability to choose the best takes

Ability to cut boring footage aggressively

Ability to make outdoor footage exciting

Ability to sync scope-cam footage, reenactment footage, and talking footage

Good sound design

Good captions

Fast turnaround time

Attention to detail

Willingness to revise edits

Bonus Skills:



Experience editing hunting, fishing, survival, outdoor, tactical, sports, or documentary-style content

Experience editing YouTube channels

Experience creating viral Shorts/Reels

Experience with retention editing

Experience with sound design

Experience with cinematic outdoor edits

Deliverables May Include:



8–15 minute YouTube video

15–30 minute YouTube video if needed

30–60 second Shorts/Reels

Captions

Sound effects

Music

Final exported video

Project file when requested

How to Apply:



Please send:



Your video editing portfolio

Your best YouTube-style edit

Any outdoor, hunting, survival, sports, documentary, or cinematic edits you have done

The software you use

Your expected monthly rate or per-video rate

Your internet speed

Your computer specs

How many long-form videos per week you can realistically edit

How many Shorts per week you can realistically edit

To prove you read this full post, put this at the top of your application:



“I understand retention editing.”



Test Task:



Shortlisted applicants may be given a short paid or unpaid test edit using sample footage.



The test will show whether you understand:



Fast pacing

Jump cuts

Best-take selection

Captions

Sound effects

Story flow

Viewer retention

Cutting boring footage

I am looking for someone long-term. If you are fast, skilled, reliable, and creative, this can become consistent monthly work.

c) Mystery / a secret just for her. Drop your voice low and slow, like you're letting her in on something: "The reason I'm calling, John, is that Dr. Bart built a system for clinics just like yours — so your staff isn't running around, everyone gets coordinated automatically and your billings go up."

2. Tell me about one inbound or outbound account you've coached — and one specific delivery problem you fixed.

description:
About the business



I run a web design and development consultancy serving US-based clients. I handle strategy, design direction, client relationships, and sales. I also work with developers who help execute the web development projects.



The business is growing, but too many operational details still depend on me.



The real problem



Client requests, developer follow-ups, task tracking, timelines, invoices, and project updates all flow through me. When I get busy, replies take too long, completed work waits for review, invoices get delayed, and project details slip.



I need someone reliable to help run the operational layer around the work so I can focus on strategy, design, and sales.



Your job is to help make sure:



Clients get timely responses

Developers know exactly what needs to be done

Completed work doesn't sit unreviewed

Notion stays accurate

Invoices are prepared on time

I know what needs my attention each morning





What you'll do



Client communication support:



Monitor client requests in Gmail and other channels I give you access to

Draft replies, follow-ups, and project updates for my review

Prepare weekly client update drafts based on project progress

Send new-client welcome
s and help make sure the onboarding process runs smoothly

Flag anything urgent, unclear, or at risk of becoming a problem





Task and project coordination:



Turn client requests into clear internal tasks for developers

Keep Notion updated with tasks, statuses, owners, and deadlines

Watch for stalled tasks and follow up

Prepare a daily brief showing what needs attention, what's blocked, and what's next





Developer follow-up:



Monitor developer submissions

Check whether the delivered work matches the client request

Do basic QA: links, copy, responsive behavior, forms, screenshots, and obvious inconsistencies

If something is incomplete or unclear, ask the developer to fix or clarify it





Admin and invoicing:



Prepare invoices using my existing formula and template

Organize project notes and client information

Help document repeatable processes as SOPs while we work, so the system gets stronger over time





What this role is NOT:



This is not a passive "wait for instructions" role.



I need someone who follows up, notices when something is sitting too long, and reminds me when I'm the bottleneck. If a developer submission has been waiting for review, you ping me. If a client request is unclear, you flag it. If a deadline is getting close, you bring it up early. You help create the operating system around my work, so fewer things depend on my memory.



You won't make final decisions on client communication, scope, pricing, or invoices at first. I'll approve anything client-facing or financial before it goes out. But you'll own the preparation and the follow-up. As trust builds, you'll get more autonomy over routine decisions.



Requirements:



Excellent written English. You'll draft
s my US clients read. This is non-negotiable.

Strong attention to detail. The whole point is that nothing falls through the cracks.

Hands-on Notion experience. You should already know how to work in it.

Comfortable organizing tasks, deadlines, and project information.

Proactive communication. You follow up and don't go silent.

Comfortable working asynchronously across time zones.

Reliable internet (with a backup plan for outages) and a quiet setup for occasional video calls.

Bonus: experience with web design, web development, agencies, project coordination, or client service.





Working style



You should be structured, communicative, and comfortable reminding people (including me) when something needs attention. I'm looking for someone who creates order, not someone who needs every next step explained every day.



How to apply

/Teams

title: Founding Technical Partner to Architect a Self-Healing, Al-Operated Company on AWS (Revenue Share + Exit Stake)
description:
This is not a task on a list. This is the engine.

I am building TalkTuit, an AI communications platform for the trades, plumbing and HVAC first. The product is the entry point. The real company is something rarer: a business that largely runs itself, where AI agents find leads, build and deliver each client's system, onboard them, watch the numbers, and repair their own failures before anyone notices.

I need one person, or one tight team, to architect and build that engine on AWS. Not a piece of it. The whole thing.

A bit about why this matters to me, because it tells you what kind of partner I am. I came up in the trades. About ten years ago a spinal cord injury left me quadriplegic, and I run this entire company by voice. I know exactly what it feels like to miss the phone while you are buried in a job, because I have lived both sides of it. I am not looking for hands to rent. I am looking for a great engineer who wants to keep doing what they are great at, on something that actually means something, and own a real piece of the outcome.

What you would build

The depth here is real, so I will be straight about it:

 The voice layer: production grade AI voice agents (Retell, Vapi, ElevenLabs, Twilio) that answer, book, route, and summarize calls and sound genuinely human.

 The integration layer: connect those agents to ANY CRM a client already runs, through APIs and webhooks, never locked to one platform.

 The automation layer: end to end workflows (n8n and similar) that onboard clients, sync data, and run the business with as little human touch as possible.

 The growth engine: an automated demo system where a prospect replies to an
 and, within minutes, the system provisions a number, builds a personalized voice demo from their website, and sends it to them to try.

 The self-healing layer: monitoring and recovery so each client system and each internal system diagnoses and repairs itself, plus a recurring automated audit that catches problems before the client ever sees them.

 All of it on AWS, data rich, cost efficient at scale, documented, and clean enough to transfer at an exit.

Who you are

 You have built and shipped real production systems on AWS, not just demos.

 You live in AI agents and automation, and you can reason about architecture, not just wire up tools.

 Voice AI experience is a strong plus. CRM and API integration experience is a strong plus.

 You can work mostly independently and own outcomes, with some overlap with US Eastern time for working sessions.

 A person or a small team is both fine. If you bring a bench, even better.

This is a partnership, not a job

So we do not waste each other's time: this is structured as a partnership for the right fit. Revenue share that begins when revenue does, plus participation in the company's exit. Real upside, tied to what you help build, with the heavy lifting front loaded and the rewards compounding behind it. I keep majority ownership and control. You get a stake worth caring about. We talk specifics once we both know it is a fit.

If you want a steady hourly ticket with daily tasks handed to you, this honestly is not it, and that is okay.

The honest bar

I have interviewed a lot of people. This is one final round to find the rare fit I have not met yet. If the scope excited you instead of scaring you, I want to hear from you.

How to apply

Start your message with the word BUILT so I know you read this all the way through. Then tell me, in your own words:

 The most complex system you have built on AWS, and your specific role in it.

 Whether you work solo or bring a team, and who does what.

 One thing in the scope above you would architect differently, and why.

Show me something real you have built if you can. I read every serious message myself.

Let us build something that should not be possible.

mbers

ssaging, channel monitoring)

title: Lead Vendor Manager
description:
# Lead Vendor Manager



## Job Overview



We are looking for a strong, organized, and highly assertive **Lead Vendor Manager** to manage and grow our network of lead vendors. This person will be responsible for finding new vendors, onboarding them into our system, making sure they understand our rules, managing day-to-day vendor communication, handling disputes, tracking performance, and coordinating vendor payments.



This role is not for someone passive. We need someone who can build relationships but also hold vendors accountable, enforce standards, and protect the company from bad traffic, poor-quality leads, compliance issues, and unnecessary payment disputes.



The ideal candidate is confident, direct, detail-oriented, and comfortable dealing with high-volume vendor communication.



## Key Responsibilities



### Vendor Recruiting & Relationship Building



* Actively search for and solicit new lead vendors.

* Build relationships with vendors who can generate qualified insurance leads or transferred calls.

* Explain our program, qualification standards, payment structure, and compliance rules.

* Maintain a pipeline of potential vendors and follow up consistently.

* Help evaluate whether new vendors are a good fit before they are approved.



### Vendor Onboarding



* Guide new vendors through the onboarding process.

* Make sure vendors are set up correctly in our vendor system.

* Train vendors on call requirements, lead qualifications, transfer expectations, hours of operation, and compliance rules.

* Confirm that vendors understand what is billable and non-billable before they begin sending traffic.

* Work with internal tea
mbers to make sure vendor setup, tracking, and reporting are accurate.



### Vendor Performance Management



* Monitor vendor lead/call quality.

* Track vendor volume, conversion quality, disputes, rejected leads, and payment trends.

* Identify vendors who are sending low-quality traffic or failing to follow instructions.

* Communicate clearly with vendors when performance needs to improve.

* Recommend pausing, reducing, or terminating vendor relationships when needed.



### Dispute Management



* Handle vendor disputes professionally and firmly.

* Review disputed calls/leads against company rules and qualification standards.

* Communicate payment decisions clearly to vendors.

* Keep organized records of disputes, approvals, rejections, and final outcomes.

* Protect the company from paying for unqualified or non-compliant leads.



### Vendor Payments



* Prepare and review vendor payment reports.

* Confirm billable leads/calls before payment is issued.

* Coordinate weekly vendor payouts.

* Track payment history and resolve payment-related questions.

* Make sure vendors are paid accurately and on time when they meet requirements.



### Compliance & Quality Control



* Ensure vendors follow company guidelines, including DNC requirements, transfer rules, scripting expectations, and call quality standards.

* Watch for red flags such as misrepresentation, poor-quality transfers, recycled leads, non-qualified prospects, or compliance violations.

* Escalate serious vendor issues quickly.

* Maintain clean documentation around vendor rules, disputes, and performance.



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal person for this role is:



* Assertive and confident

* Comfortable having difficult conversations

* Not easily pushed around by vendors

* Organized and detail-oriented

* Strong at follow-up

* Able to balance relationship-building with accountability

* Comfortable enforcing rules and saying “no”

* Fast-moving and proactive

* Good with systems, spreadsheets, CRM tools, and reporting

* Able to manage multiple vendors at once without losing track of details



## Required Skills & Experience



* Experience managing vendors, lead providers, affiliates, call centers, or marketing partners preferred

* Experience in insurance, pay-per-call, lead generation, sales, or performance marketing is a strong plus

* Strong written and verbal communication skills

* Strong negotiation and conflict-resolution skills

* Ability to review data, reports, calls, and dispute records

* High attention to detail

* Comfortable working in a fast-paced sales environment

* Ability to enforce rules without damaging productive relationships

* Reliable, accountable, and self-managed



## Personality Fit



This role requires someone with a strong personality. You must be able to push back when vendors are wrong, challenge questionable traffic, and enforce standards without needing constant direction.



We want someone who is professional and respectful, but also firm, direct, and not afraid of confrontation when necessary.



## Success in This Role Looks Like



* New vendors are consistently being recruited and onboarded.

* Vendors clearly understand our expectations before sending traffic.

* Disputes are handled quickly and fairly.

* Payments are accurate and organized.

* Bad vendors are identified and addressed quickly.

* Good vendors are supported and encouraged to scale.

* Internal teams have fewer vendor-related issues.

* Lead/call quality improves over time.



## Compensation



Compensation will depend on experience and role structure. This may include a base salary or hourly pay, with potential performance bonuses based on vendor growth, quality, and volume.



## How to Apply



Please apply with your resume and a short note explaining your experience managing vendors, affiliates, lead sources, call centers, or similar relationships.



Bonus points if you have experience in insurance, lead generation, pay-per-call, or performance marketing.

title: Market Research & Investment Research Virtual Assistant
description:
Market Research & Investment Research Virtual Assistant



Company: NextVerra

Position: Market Research & Investment Research Virtual Assistant

Type: Part-Time or Full-Time

Schedule: U.S. market hours preferred

Location: Remote

Pay: Starting at $4–$6/hr depending on experience and skill level



About the Role



We are looking for a detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help monitor the stock market, organize daily market research, prepare trading watchlists, and complete weekly deep-dive research reports on companies we are considering for long-term investment.



This is a research and reporting role only. You will not be giving financial advice, making investment decisions, placing trades, managing money, or telling us what to buy or sell.



The ideal candidate is reliable, organized, fast with research, interested in the stock market, and able to summarize complex information in a simple, clear way.



Main Responsibilities



Your work will include two main areas:



1. Daily market research and watchlist preparation

2. Weekly company deep-dive research for potential long-term holds



Daily Market Research Responsibilities



Each day, you may be responsible for:



* Monitoring pre-market movers

* Finding stocks with unusual volume

* Tracking stocks with major news or catalysts

* Reviewing earnings announcements

* Tracking analyst upgrades and downgrades

* Watching major ETFs such as SPY, QQQ, and sector ETFs

* Identifying stocks that match our written criteria

* Preparing a daily watchlist

* Summarizing why each stock is moving

* Identifying basic support and resistance levels

* Tracking risk factors for each ticker

* Organizing source links for all research

* Maintaining a trading research spreadsheet

* Tracking hypothetical/paper trade ideas for review

* Creating end-of-day performance summaries



Weekly Long-Term Company Research



Each week, you will complete one detailed research report on a company we choose.



The purpose of this report is to help us understand the company better as a possible long-term investment. You will not recommend whether to buy or sell. Your job is to provide clear, organized research.



Each weekly company report should include:



* Company overview

* Ticker symbol and exchange

* What the company does

* Main products or services

* How the company makes money

* Revenue streams

* Target customers

* Industry overview

* Market size and growth potential

* Main competitors

* Competitive advantages

* Weaknesses or disadvantages

* Leadership team overview

* Recent earnings summary

* Revenue growth trends

* Profitability trends

* Debt and cash position

* Free cash flow overview, if available

* Valuation overview

* Analyst opinions and price targets

* Recent news and catalysts

* Insider buying or selling, if available

* Institutional ownership, if available

* Bull case

* Bear case

* Major risks

* Long-term growth opportunities

* Key questions we should answer before considering an investment

* Final neutral summary of whether the company appears strong, weak, risky, or worth watching further



The report should include source links and be written in simple language that a business owner can understand.



Important Role Boundaries



This position is for research, organization, and reporting only.



You will not:



* Give financial advice

* Tell us what to buy or sell

* Place trades

* Access brokerage accounts

* Manage investment accounts

* Guarantee profits

* Be paid based on trading results

* Make final investment decisions



All trading and investing decisions are made internally.



Tools You May Use



Experience with these tools is preferred, but not required:



* TradingView

* Finviz

* Yahoo Finance

* MarketWatch

* CNBC

* Benzinga

* Seeking Alpha

* Google Finance

* SEC filings

* Company investor relations pages

* Earnings call transcripts

* Google Sheets

* Google Docs

* ChatGPT or other AI research tools



Required Skills



We are looking for someone who has:



* Strong English reading and writing skills

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to follow written instructions exactly

* Ability to research quickly and accurately

* Basic understanding of stocks and financial markets

* Basic understanding of charts, volume, catalysts, and news

* Ability to summarize complex information clearly

* Experience using Google Sheets and Google Docs

* Reliable communication during work hours

* High integrity and honesty

* Willingness to learn our process

* Ability to admit when you do not know something



Preferred Experience



Bonus points if you have experience with:



* Stock market research

* Day trading research

* Long-term investment research

* Technical analysis

* Fundamental analysis

* Reading earnings reports

* Reading financial statements

* Preparing investment summaries

* Maintaining trading journals

* Building research dashboards

* Working as a VA for a business owner, trader, investor, or finance company



Experience is helpful, but honesty, accuracy, speed, and coachability are more important.



Daily Report Example



A daily market report may include:



* Overall market summary

* SPY and QQQ trend summary

* Top pre-market movers

* Top stocks with unusual volume

* Stocks with major news catalysts

* Earnings movers

* Analyst upgrades/downgrades

* Sector strength or weakness

* Watchlist tickers that match our written criteria

* Key levels to watch

* Risk notes

* Source links

* End-of-day recap



Weekly Report Example



A weekly company research assignment may look like this:



Research Tesla, Nvidia, Palantir, Apple, Amazon, or another company of our choosing as a potential long-term hold.



Do not recommend whether to buy or sell. Create a complete research report covering the company’s business model, financial health, growth opportunities, risks, competition, valuation, leadership, recent earnings, recent news, bull case, bear case, and key questions we should answer before considering an investment.



Ideal Candidate



You may be a great fit if you:



* Enjoy studying the market

* Like researching companies

* Are naturally curious

* Are highly organized

* Can follow a checklist every day

* Communicate quickly

* Are honest and reliable

* Like turning messy information into simple summaries

* Want a long-term role with room to grow

* Are comfortable working during U.S. market hours



Work Schedule



U.S. market hours are preferred.



Ideal availability would include some or all of the following:



* Pre-market research before the U.S. market opens

* Market monitoring during U.S. market hours

* End-of-day recap after market close

* Weekly company research report submitted by the agreed deadline



We are open to part-time or full-time depending on experience and availability.



Compensation



Starting pay is $4–$6 per hour, depending on experience, communication skills, research ability, and performance on the test task.



There is room for growth for the right person.



How to Apply



Please respond with the following:



1. Your experience with stock market research or investing

2. Your experience with day trading research, if any

3. Your experience with long-term company research, if any

4. Tools or websites you have used for market research

5. Your experience with Google Sheets and Google Docs

6. Your availability during U.S. market hours

7. Your expected hourly rate

8. Your internet speed and computer setup

9. A short explanation of how you would research a stock that is moving up quickly before market open

10. A short explanation of how you would research a company as a possible long-term investment



Please include the word WATCHLIST in your application so we know you read the full post.



Screening Questions



Please answer these questions:



1. Have you ever researched stocks before? Explain your experience.

2. What websites or tools would you use to find pre-market movers?

3. What does trading volume tell you?

4. What is a market catalyst?

5. What is the difference between a short-term trade setup and a long-term investment idea?

6. What is support and resistance?

7. What financial information would you review when researching a company for a long-term hold?

8. What would you look for in a company’s earnings report?

9. How would you summarize negative news about a company?

10. Are you comfortable working during U.S. market hours?

11. Are you comfortable following a strict checklist?

12. Do you understand that this role does not involve giving financial advice, placing trades, or managing money?

13. Why do you think you would be good at this role?



Paid Test Task



Before hiring, we may ask you to complete a paid test task.



Part 1: Daily Market Research Test



Choose 3 stocks moving pre-market today.



For each stock, provide:



* Ticker

* Company name

* Current price

* Pre-market percentage move

* Volume

* Reason it is moving

* Main news catalyst

* Key support and resistance levels

title: Short-Form TikTok Editor (Spark Creator)
description:
SALARY: PHP 90,000–120,000/month (~$1,600–$2,100 USD) — with performance bonuses and raises as you prove out.



Hours: Full-time, structured daily schedule







Read this part first - 



Most editing jobs on here are churn-and-burn: vague briefs, no system, a client who disappears, and you're treated as disposable. This is the opposite. I'm building a small, elite team around a paid TikTok ad operation that's already working. I run on documented systems, clear SOPs, and clean structure. I pay top-of-market because I'm hiring one person for this seat and I want the best editor sitting in it, long-term.



If you're genuinely elite at native, organic-style TikTok editing — the kind that looks like a real person filmed it, not a brand ad — and you want a stable seat where there's a real path to grow with the company: keep reading.









The mission -



We produce high-volume, native-style TikTok content we call Sparks — short videos engineered to stop the scroll and pull a real reaction in the first second. Not corporate. Not YouTube-style. Not polished brand ads. Raw, fast, native-to-the-FYP content that looks organic and converts.



You'll work from briefs, hooks, references, and a documented Spark SOP. You're not inventing 50 videos from scratch — you're running a proven creative system at speed: core builds, hook swaps, variations, recuts. The system is mapped. Your job is to execute it at elite quality and volume, every single day, and to make each Spark feel native and alive.







What you'll do -



• Produce 30–50 Sparks/day off our documented system — core builds plus rapid variations (new hooks, new openers, recuts)



• Nail a specific native-FYP style from our reference library — casual, organic, scroll-stopping



• Work fluently with slideshows, text-on-screen, native captions, trending audio, and quick-cut footage



• Follow our naming, formatting, and delivery system precisely (clean operators win here)



• Hit daily output targets without the quality ever dropping



• Take feedback fast, iterate faster, and bring your own instincts for what makes a video hit







Who I'm looking for (non-negotiable) -



• Proven native-style short-form work — TikTok / Reels / Shorts in the casual, organic look (not brand promos). Your portfolio is the proof.



• Genuine speed with quality — you can produce volume without it ever looking mass-produced



• CapCut fluency (Premiere a plus) — fast, clean, precise



• Deep feel for TikTok pacing: 1-second hooks, fast cuts, native text styling, trend awareness



• Reliable daily availability and sharp, consistent communication



• Stable internet + a machine that handles daily video work without choking







What makes you stand out -



• Experience editing for paid ads / performance marketing, not just organic creators



• A real instinct for why a video stops the scroll vs. gets skipped



• Fluency in US-audience TikTok trends, humor, and rhythm







Why this seat is worth it -



• Top-of-market pay (?90k–?120k), with bonuses tied to winning Sparks and raises as you prove out. 



• Stability — this is a long-term core seat, not a one-off gig. I want you here for years. 



• Real systems — documented SOPs, clean briefs, reference libraries. You'll never be guessing.



• Growth path — as trust builds, this seat can grow into a lead creative role as the team expands



• Respect — your work is the engine of the business, and you'll be treated that way







How to apply (follow exactly — anything that skips a step is deleted) -



This is a competitive seat. I read every application that follows the steps, and I ignore every one that doesn't. 







Do all four:



• Put the word SCROLL at the very top of your application, so I know you read this in full.



• Send 3 examples of native-style TikTok / Reels / Shorts videos you personally edited. They must be the casual, organic-looking style — not corporate or brand promos. Make sure the links actually work.



• In 2–3 sentences, answer: What makes a TikTok hook stop someone from scrolling in the first 1 second?

Strong applicants who show real native work and a sharp answer to #3 move to a paid test edit (a real Spark from a real brief). Nail the test and you're in.



I'm hiring one person for this. Make me certain it's you.

title: Ecommerce Finance & Operations Assistant
description:
# Ecommerce Finance & Operations Assistant for Shopify Clothing Brand



## About Us



Sunset Surf is a fast-growing clothing brand selling premium embroidered coastal hoodies. We are scaling through Shopify, Meta ads, creator content, inventory restocks, wholesale, and brand trips.



We are looking for a detail-oriented Ecommerce Finance & Operations Assistant who can help us track our business numbers clearly every week and every month.



This role is not a logistics role. We already have someone helping with logistics. This role is focused on tracking money, expenses, payments, inventory costs, QuickBooks, Shopify payouts, and monthly reports.



## What We Need Help With



We need someone who can help us clearly understand:



* How much money came in

* How much money went out

* How much we spent on inventory

* How much we spent on workers, creators, and contractors

* How much we spent on Meta ads

* How much we spent on brand trips

* How much cash is tied up in inventory

* How much inventory has sold

* How much inventory is still left to sell

* Estimated monthly profit

* Upcoming payments and expenses



The goal is to help us see a clear picture of the business every week and month.



## Main Responsibilities



* Track Shopify sales and payouts

* Compare Shopify payouts to bank deposits

* Track QuickBooks transactions

* Organize and categorize expenses in QuickBooks

* Track inventory purchases

* Track cost per hoodie/SKU

* Track how much cash is tied up in inventory

* Track units sold and units remaining

* Track creator, contractor, and worker payments

* Track Meta ad spend

* Track product/sample costs

* Track brand trip spending

* Track receipts and invoices

* Maintain Google Sheets or Excel trackers

* Prepare weekly financial summaries

* Prepare monthly spending and profit summaries

* Flag missing expenses, unusual payments, or cash-flow concerns

* Work with our bookkeeper/CPA when needed



## Initial Project



The first project will be to organize and track financial data from January 1st of this year to present.



This includes:



* Shopify payouts

* Business expenses

* Inventory purchases

* Creator/contractor payments

* Worker payments

* Meta ad spend

* Brand trip expenses

* Software/app subscriptions

* Product/sample costs

* Monthly summaries



After the initial setup, this will become an ongoing weekly and monthly tracking role.



## Brand Trip Tracking



For brand trips, we mainly need spending tracked clearly.



You will track:



* Trip name

* Location

* Date

* Budget

* Flights

* Hotel/Airbnb

* Food

* Uber/rental car

* Activities

* Creator payments

* Products gifted

* Photographer/videographer costs

* Decorations/props

* Miscellaneous expenses

* Total spent

* Whether the trip was over or under budget

* Receipts and payment dates



We want to clearly see how much we are spending on brand trips each month.



## Inventory Tracking Example



If we buy 1,000 hoodies at $30 each, that is $30,000 spent upfront.



If each hoodie sells for $99, that inventory has $99,000 in potential revenue.



We need help tracking:



* Total inventory cost

* Units received

* Units sold

* Units remaining

* Revenue generated so far

* Remaining inventory value

* How much cash is still tied up in inventory



This helps us understand where our money is and how much inventory still needs to sell.



## Tools You Should Know



You must be comfortable with:



* QuickBooks

* Shopify

* Google Sheets or Excel

* Basic ecommerce reporting

* Expense tracking

* Cash-flow tracking



Experience with these is a bonus:



* Meta Ads Manager

* TrueProfit

* BeProfit

* Inventory Planner

* Settle

* Finaloop

* Ecommerce bookkeeping

* Apparel or clothing brands

* Inventory/COGS tracking



## Ideal Candidate



You are a good fit if you are:



* Very organized

* Strong with numbers

* Experienced with QuickBooks

* Experienced with Shopify

* Comfortable with spreadsheets

* Detail-oriented

* Reliable with weekly updates

* Good at spotting missing expenses or mistakes

* Comfortable asking questions when something does not make sense

* Able to create simple, clear reports

* Experienced with ecommerce businesses



## Important



You will not have control over bank transfers or final payment approvals.



Your role is to track, organize, report, and help us understand the numbers.



Final payments, banking decisions, tax decisions, and accounting decisions will be handled by the owner and/or bookkeeper/CPA.



## Weekly Report



Every week, we want a simple report showing:



* Total sales

* Total Shopify payouts

* Total expenses

* Meta ad spend

* Creator/contractor/worker payments

* Inventory payments

* Brand trip expenses

* Estimated profit

* Upcoming bills/payments

* Any missing receipts or concerns

* Any cash-flow notes



## Monthly Report



Every month, we want a summary showing:



* Total revenue

* Total expenses

* Estimated profit

* Inventory purchased

* Inventory sold

* Cash tied up in inventory

* Creator/content spend

* Worker/contractor spend

* Brand trip spend

* Ad spend

* Software/app expenses

* Areas where we may be overspending

* Big payments coming up next month



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your experience with Shopify

2. Your experience with QuickBooks

3. Examples of ecommerce finance, bookkeeping, or operations tracking work you have done

4. Your experience with inventory, COGS, or cash-flow tracking

5. Your experience with Google Sheets or Excel

6. Your hourly or monthly rate

7. Your availability

8. Any ecommerce finance tools you recommend



Please also answer this question:



If a brand spends $30,000 on inventory upfront, but that inventory will sell over the next few months, how would you track that so the owner understands both cash flow and profit?



Thank you!

title: Photo Ad Designer for Shopify Clothing Brand
description:
# Photo Ad Designer for Shopify Clothing Brand



## About Us



Sunset Surf is a fast-growing clothing brand selling premium embroidered coastal hoodies. We are scaling through Shopify, Meta ads, creator content, product launches, and brand trips.



We are looking for a creative photo ad designer who can design high-performing static ads for Meta, Instagram,
, and other paid/social channels.



This role is focused on creating simple, clean, high-converting photo ads using product photos, lifestyle photos, creator images, review screenshots, product details, and ad copy.



## Role Overview



We need someone who can create strong static ads that feel premium, scroll-stopping, and on-brand.



You will help turn our products, photos, reviews, and marketing angles into ad creatives that can be tested in Meta ads.



The goal is not just to make pretty designs. The goal is to create photo ads that get attention, communicate the value of the product quickly, and help drive purchases.



## Main Responsibilities



* Design static photo ads for Meta/Facebook/Instagram

* Create product-focused ad creatives

* Create lifestyle/photo-based ad creatives

* Create review/testimonial ad creatives

* Create sale, restock, launch, and best-seller ads

* Create embroidery/detail-focused ads

* Create simple ad variations using different hooks, headlines, layouts, and images

* Resize ads for different placements when needed

* Keep designs clean, premium, and easy to read

* Work with provided product photos, creator photos, brand assets, and ad concepts

* Organize final creatives in folders

* Create multiple variations for testing

* Follow brand direction and improve based on ad performance feedback



## Types of Ads We Need



Examples of static ads we want to test:



* Product photo ads

* Lifestyle photo ads

* Review/testimonial ads

* Before/after or comparison-style ads

* “Embroidered, not printed” ads

* “Your new favorite hoodie” ads

* “The hoodie brand of the summer” ads

* “Feels like wearing a blanket” ads

* Best-seller ads

* Restock ads

* Limited drop ads

* Carousel graphics

* Simple creator-photo ads

* Social proof ads

* Detail/close-up embroidery ads



## Design Style



We are looking for designs that feel:



* Clean

* Premium

* Coastal

* Fun

* Bright

* Modern

* Easy to read

* Not overly corporate

* Not cluttered

* Strong enough for paid ads



The ads should feel like they fit a beachy/coastal clothing brand, but still be direct and conversion-focused.



## Tools You Should Know



You should be experienced with:



* Canva, Photoshop, Figma, or Adobe Illustrator

* Designing for Meta ads

* Designing for Instagram/Facebook

* Basic direct response ad design

* Working with product photography

* Creating multiple creative variations quickly



Bonus if you have experience with:



* Shopify brands

* Clothing/apparel brands

* Fashion or lifestyle ads

* Meta ad creatives

* UGC-style static ads

* Ecommerce conversion design

* Creative testing

* Klaviyo/email graphics



## What We Will Provide



We can provide:



* Product photos

* Lifestyle photos

* Creator photos

* Brand colors/fonts

* Product benefits

* Winning ad angles

* Customer reviews

* Examples of ad styles we like

* Creative direction

* Feedback based on ad performance



## Weekly Deliverables



We are looking for someone who can consistently create batches of static ads.



Example deliverables may include:



* 10–20 static ad designs per week

* Multiple variations of winning concepts

* Resized versions for placements when needed

* Organized files and editable source files



The exact weekly volume can be discussed based on your availability, pricing, and speed.



## Ideal Candidate



You are a good fit if you:



* Have strong visual design skills

* Understand ecommerce ads

* Can design for conversion, not just aesthetics

* Are fast and organized

* Can take direction and feedback

* Can create multiple ad variations

* Understand clean typography and layout

* Know how to make product benefits clear quickly

* Have experience designing for Meta/Facebook/Instagram ads

* Can match a brand style while still testing new creative angles



## Important



We are not looking for overly complicated designs.



Many of the best-performing ads are simple, clear, and direct.



We need someone who can create designs that quickly communicate why someone would want the hoodie, such as:



* Soft fleece inside

* Premium quality

* Detailed embroidery

* Coastal/beachy designs

* Comfortable fit

* Easy to style

* Great for everyday wear



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your design portfolio

2. Examples of ecommerce or clothing brand ads you have designed

3. Your experience designing Meta/Facebook/Instagram ads

4. What tools you use

5. Your weekly availability

6. Your rate per design, per batch, or per month

7. How many static ads you can create per week

8. Your favorite style of ad creative to design



Please also answer this question:



If we gave you one hoodie product photo, one customer review, and one product benefit, how would you turn that into 3 different static ad concepts?



Thank you!

description:
We are looking for a data-driven, highly technical Klaviyo Specialist (our "Klaviyo Ninja") to manage, optimize, and scale our

Duties and Responsibilities:

Flow Optimization: Review, audit, and continuously A/B test our core automated flows (Welcome Series, Abandoned Cart, Post-Purchase, Win-back, etc.) to improve open rates, click rates, and revenue.



Advanced Segmentation: Build and maintain hyper-targeted segments based on purchasing behavior, engagement history, and custom data attributes to ensure personalized messaging.



Deliverability Management: Monitor sender reputation, manage domain authentication (DKIM, SPF, DMARC), handle list cleaning/sunsetting policies, and ensure we stay out of the spam folder.



Integrations & Technical Setup: Manage the integration between Klaviyo and our e-commerce platform (Shopify), troubleshooting custom tracking scripts, API connections, and meta-fields.

Proven Klaviyo Expertise: Minimum 2–3 years of hands-on experience managing Klaviyo for e-commerce brands (Klaviyo Certification is a massive plus).



Analytical Mindset: You look at a drop in open rates and immediately know how to diagnose if it's a deliverability issue or a segmentation issue.



Technical Literacy: Comfort working with Shopify/e-commerce integrations, understanding how web tracking pixels work, and basic knowledge of HTML/CSS for formatting templates.



Attention to Detail: You double-check every trigger, time delay, and exclusion filter before a flow goes live.

title: Amazon FBA Used Book Sourcing - Remote Requisitions Contractor
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION



A US-based company is seeking Remote Requisition Contractors based in the Philippines to source, analyze, and, when authorized, purchase used books for resale through Amazon FBA.



This is not a general VA role and not a training opportunity. This is a specialized buying and analysis engagement requiring strong attention to detail, accurate Keepa interpretation, sound purchasing judgement, and the ability to follow detailed sourcing criteria.



Contractors will help identify used books available on the Amazon marketplace that may be profitably resold through Amazon FBA. Standard purchase criteria are based on projected ROI, projected profit, and expected turnover.





CONTRACT STRUCTURE



This is an independent contractor engagement, not an employee position. Contractor is responsible for managing their own work methods, tools, hardware, internet access, taxes, and time.



The selection process is multi-stage:

- Application

- Written evaluation covering sourcing concepts, theory, and Keepa interpretation

- Onboarding

- Paid trial period

- Paid sourcing evaluation period

- Ongoing contractor engagement with potential bonus eligibility





RESPONSIBILITIES



- Source used books from the Amazon marketplace

- Interpret Keepa charts to estimate demand, price behavior, offer-count trends, and sales likelihood

- Determine whether a book meets assigned ROI, profit, and turnover objectives

- Use sourcing and analysis tools such as Keepa, BookMine, BooksRun Counterfeit Book Checker, SellerAmp, and Google Sheets

- Check current inventory before making sourcing decisions

- Log sourcing and purchase details accurately in Google Sheets

- Follow assigned sourcing objectives, spending limits, and purchase authority limits

- Maintain accurate time tracking through Jibble

- Communicate clearly through WhatsApp when needed





REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Strong English reading and writing ability

- Strong attention to detail

- Ability to interpret Keepa data and/or demonstrated ability to learn advanced sourcing analysis independently

- Comfortable using Google Sheets

- Reliable high-speed internet

- Computer suitable for sourcing work

- Willingness to use Jibble for time tracking

- Willingness to communicate through WhatsApp

- Willingness to submit invoices in USD and receive payment through Wise

- Valid government-issued photo ID and clearance





PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Prior experience sourcing used books for resale on Amazon

- Prior experience using Keepa Product Finder or Keepa Deals

- Prior experience with SellerAmp, BookMine, FlipMine, Zen Arbitrage, Tactical Arbitrage, or similar sourcing tools

- Understanding of Amazon FBA, used book pricing, sales rank, offer count, buy box behavior, and seasonal book demand

- Experience working in performance-based sourcing or online arbitrage roles





TOOLS AND ACCESS



- Contractors are required to use their own Keepa Premium subscription. (Subscription reimbursement is available to eligible contractors.)

- After the trial stage, contract work will take place within the company’s secure remote workspace, where relevant tools for the services are accessible.





COMPENSATION



This two-part compensation model is performance-oriented. It is designed for contractors who want to be rewarded for strong results, not only for time worked. The hourly service rate provides a base, but the larger earning opportunity is intended to come through performance-based discretionary bonuses after the conclusion of the evaluation period. Bonus potential is based on measurable sourcing results, including profitability, ROI, accuracy, productivity, and sell-through performance.



- This contract includes a base hourly service rate of $3 USD for approved billable service hours.

- Eligible contractors can qualify for performance-based discretionary bonuses that allow strong performers to substantially increase their total compensation through consistent, profitable sourcing results.

- A monthly Keepa Premium reimbursement is available to eligible contractors.

- A monthly internet allowance is available to eligible contractors.





WHO SHOULD APPLY



Apply if you are analytical, careful, self-directed, and serious about becoming highly effective at profitable Amazon used book sourcing.



Do not apply if you are looking for basic VA work, general admin work, or a role where the company provides all training from scratch. Contractors are expected to take responsibility for maintaining and improving the skills needed to provide high-quality sourcing services.





HOW TO APPLY



To apply, please complete both steps:



Step 1) Complete the application form here: 

Step 2) After submitting the form, return to this OnlineJobs job post and click Apply or send a message through OnlineJobs. In your OnlineJobs message:

   - Include your name as it appears on your application form.

   - Indicate that you have submitted an application.



Applications that do not include both the Google Form submission and an OnlineJobs message may not be reviewed.

title: Social Media Design, Video & Posting Specialist
description:
About the Role



We have a Family App that is a Shared Life Operating System, an iOS app helping households coordinate planning, meals, tasks, memories, and milestones in one shared hub. We're in final pre-launch preparation and looking for a reliable, detail-oriented designer to take over recurring social media content execution and publishing from our existing templates and content calendar.



This is not a strategy or growth role. We already have the brand templates, content calendar, and brand voice guidelines built. We need someone who can execute against them consistently, accurately, and on schedule.





Core Responsibilities





Design execution: Populate existing Canva/Figma templates with new content (text, images, branding) for each scheduled post, following our content calendar.

Video editing: Edit short-form video content (Reels, TikToks) from raw footage and/or approved animation scripts, following our brand templates and style. This includes basic cuts, captions, music/sound syncing, and export formatting for each platform.

Scheduling and publishing: Post approved content (both static designs and video) to FamOnea's social channels (Instagram, TikTok, etc.) on the agreed cadence, using our scheduling tools.

Quality control: Catch your own errors before posting — typos, off-brand phrasing, incorrect template usage, broken links.

Light reporting: Confirm what was posted each week against the calendar; flag anything that couldn't be completed and why.





Stretch Responsibility (Not Required to Start)





Post idea pitches: Once you're fully ramped up on our brand voice and templates, you may be invited to suggest post ideas within our five content pillars. All ideas go through founder approval before moving to design — this is a growth-track add-on, not a core requirement of the role.







What This Role Is NOT





This is not a content strategy or growth marketing role.

You will not be expected to originate campaign direction, brand voice, or messaging strategy.

You will be working from clear, pre-built source materials — your job is precise, reliable execution.







Requirements





Strong working knowledge of Canva and/or Figma — must be able to work within existing templates, not just design from scratch.

Working knowledge of a video editing tool (CapCut, Premiere Rush, or similar) — comfortable cutting short-form video, adding captions/text overlays, and syncing music/sound for Reels and TikToks.

Demonstrated experience managing recurring social media posting schedules (Instagram and TikTok required; other platforms a plus).

Strong written English for reading briefs and brand guidelines accurately (copy will typically be provided, not originated).

Reliable, proactive communicator — flags blockers or questions before deadlines, not after.

Available for an estimated 8–12 hours/week, with potential to grow.





Nice to Have





Experience working from a brand style guide with strict tone-of-voice rules.

Familiarity with scheduling tools (Meta Business Suite, Later, Buffer, etc.).







How We Work





You'll receive our existing template pack, dated content calendar, and brand voice guide on day one.

All content briefs and source assets will be provided — your job is execution, not origination.

We value precision and proactive communication over speed. If something is unclear or blocked, we want to know early, not after a deadline passes.







Compensation





$4–7/hr, paid weekly/biweekly.

Rate within this range will be set based on the quality and speed of your work in the paid test task.







Paid Test Task (Required Before Hire)



Before final hire, candidates will complete a short paid test assignment:





We provide one existing template + one calendar entry (with brief and copy) for a static post, plus one short raw video clip or approved animation script.

Candidate executes 2–3 static social posts from the template, and edits the video clip into one finished short-form video (captions, basic cuts, music sync).

Candidate schedules/mocks the posting workflow for both formats (screen recording or walkthrough if full posting access isn't yet granted).





This is paid at the agreed hourly rate and used to confirm fit before committing to ongoing weekly hours.

title: Google Apps Script Engineer + Sheets Systems Builder
description:
SALARY:  PHP 50,000–90,000/month (~$900–$1,600 USD)

HOURS: Project-based to start, with a path to an ongoing seat





I'm hiring one person to automate and connect a multi-tab Google Sheets system that runs a live operation. The architecture is already well-built — tracking tasks, launches, shifts, payroll, and testing across a large structure. 





I don't need it rebuilt. I need it automated, connected, and rolled up — surgically, without breaking what works.



If you stop at VLOOKUP, this isn't your seat. If you build scripted automation AND clean multi-sheet data systems that feed dashboards and run themselves — keep reading.



---



The work — two sides, both matter:



1) Apps Script automation (`.gs`)

- Write and maintain Apps Script across a multi-tab system

- Build **triggers** — onEdit, time-based, onChange — for live workflow automation

- Diagnose and fix broken logic (a contained payroll-calculation bug is the first real task)

- Add validation, flagging, alerting, scheduled summary
s

- Connect Sheets to **external APIs** with auth + error handling where needed



2) Advanced formulas + sheet-to-dashboard data systems

- Build **multi-sheet data connections** — worker sheets rolling up into a **master dashboard**

- Fluent with **QUERY, IMPORTRANGE, INDEX/MATCH, ARRAYFORMULA, FILTER, pivot logic** — the formula stack that moves and aggregates data cleanly across tabs

- Design **data-collection flows**: individual input sheets ? consolidated master view, live and accurate

- Build dashboard views that summarize operational data (performance, labor, output) in real time



Always: build on a copy, test, then deploy. Non-negotiable.** Document everything so it stays maintainable.



---



**Non-negotiables —**



- **Real Apps Script experience** — actual `.gs` code, not just formulas

- **Advanced formula fluency** — QUERY, IMPORTRANGE, ARRAYFORMULA, INDEX/MATCH at a systems level, not single-cell

- Can build **sheet-to-sheet and sheet-to-dashboard data pipelines** that stay accurate at scale

- Can read an existing system and **extend it without breaking it** — surgical, not destructive

- Clean, documented, maintainable work

- Sharp communication, reliable availability, stable setup



**You stand out if —**



- You use **clasp** for local Apps Script development

- You've done **Apps Script + external API** integration (REST, OAuth)

- You've built **master-dashboard rollups** from multiple input sheets

- You've automated **real operational systems** — payroll, tracking, reporting — not toy demos



---



**How to apply (follow exactly — skip a step and you're deleted) —**



The instructions are the first test. I read every application that follows them. I ignore every one that doesn't.



1. Put **SCRIPT** at the very top, so I know you read this in full.

2. Share **2–3 projects you personally built** — must show **both** real `.gs` work **and** a multi-sheet/dashboard data system. Link code (GitHub/Gist), a Loom walkthrough, or a working sheet copy.

3. In 2–3 sentences: **describe one thing you automated with Apps Script that a formula couldn't do** — name the trigger and the logic.

4. In 2–3 sentences: **describe a time you connected multiple sheets into one master dashboard** — what formulas/method you used and how you kept the data accurate.

5. In one line: **how do you test before touching a live system?**



Nail this and you move to a paid test task — a small, real automation or data-connection job on a copy of my sheet. Nail that and we scope the full build.



I'm hiring one person. Show me you can both script and build clean data systems.

- Long-term role for the right person
