title: Short-Form Video Editor / Clipper — Viral Reels & TikToks (High Volume, Ongoing)
description:
READ THIS FIRST — to filter yourself in or out:



The #1 reason a short-form video gets scrolled past in the first 1 second is __________.



Answer that in 2-3 sentences from your OWN editing experience (NOT ChatGPT, NOT a template). If you can't, this role isn't for you — I'll skip applications that don't lead with that answer.



If your application starts with "I am a passionate and dedicated video editor with excellent skills" — I will skip it. I want one specific kind of editor, not a stock cover letter.



---



We're a New Zealand AI-powered marketing agency. We grow businesses and creators on short-form video (Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts), and we're producing a HIGH volume of content — aiming for ~10 finished videos per day across a small team of editors.



We're hiring SEVERAL short-form editors / clippers at once. We send you raw footage + a clear brief, you cut it into dynamic, retention-led short-form videos in the style of the best creators online. Fast turnaround, ongoing work, room to take on more videos (and more pay) as you prove out.



THE STYLE WE WANT — study these before applying:

- WATCH OUR FIRST EDITED VIDEO — this is the exact standard + style you'll be matching: 

- Devin Jatho 
 is our north star for editing style. Watch a few of his videos before you apply.

- Fast, dynamic cuts. Punchy 1-second hooks. Clean animated captions. Zooms, pattern interrupts, B-roll, sound design that lands on the beat.

- Modern, high-retention, "scroll-stopping" — NOT slow corporate edits, NOT cheesy sound-effect spam.

- We'll send the raw footage + a per-project brief so you know exactly what to cut.



WHAT THESE VIDEOS ARE FOR:

The content promotes our Social Growth Plan — 
 — a done-for-you content-strategy product for creators and founders. You'll be editing videos built to grow our audience and drive viewers to that page, so every edit needs to hold attention to the very end and land the call-to-action cleanly.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:

- Receive raw clips + a written brief (hook, beats, on-screen text, pacing notes, reference)

- Cut 9:16 vertical short-form videos to a viral standard

- Animated captions, on-screen text, trending-audio sync, tight pacing, clean exports

- Turn videos around fast — this is a volume role; ideally you can do 2+ per day

- Keep a consistent style across videos while adapting per brief



WHAT YOU NEED TO BE GOOD AT:

- Short-form editing in CapCut and/or Premiere Pro / After Effects (DaVinci fine)

- Hook-first retention editing — you understand WHY a video holds attention, not just making it pretty

- Clean animated captions + on-screen text (accurate, well-timed, on-brand)

- Working fast to a brief without quality dropping

- Clear English communication and reliable turnaround



NICE TO HAVE:

- Reusable caption / motion-graphics templates

- A feel for what's trending on Reels / TikTok right now

- Experience editing founder-led / talking-head + B-roll content



THE SETUP:

- Per-video pay (you quote your rate). Ongoing volume — the better and faster you are, the more videos we send you.

- Paid test edit: we send one set of raw clips + a brief, you return one finished short. We pay $5 USD for the test regardless of outcome.

- This is a real, ongoing role with room to grow into more videos/day and a higher per-video rate as you prove out.



HOW TO APPLY — send these THREE things, in this order:



1. Your 2-3 sentence answer to: "The #1 reason a short-form video gets scrolled past in the first 1 second is ___" (your own experience, not ChatGPT)



2. 2-3 short-form videos YOU personally edited — DIRECT video links (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, or specific Drive/Dropbox FILE links — NOT folders, NOT showreels).



3. Your per-video rate (USD) + how many videos per day you can realistically deliver.



I reply within 48 hours and pay $5 USD for a short test edit if your samples fit.



WHAT I WILL NOT REPLY TO:

- Agency
s ("we are a team of 50 editors")

- Drive-folder portfolios (send direct video links only)

- Editors who only do gaming / wedding / long-form vlog content

- Anyone whose answer to question 1 reads like ChatGPT

- Anyone who applies without watching a few Devin Jatho videos first

% remote

description:
Short Form Video Editor (Full-Time, Remote) - Z Prime Media



Pay: $5/hour, USD

Hours: 30-40 hours/week (varies by production cycle, trending toward consistent 40 as we scale)

Type: Full-time, independent contractor

Start: Immediate



About Us



Z Prime Media (ZPM) is a video marketing agency based in Michigan, USA. We produce short-form vertical video content for healthcare clients (dental and physical therapy practices), turning their expertise into talking-head videos for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube,
, and LinkedIn. We're a small, fast-moving team, and we care more about quality than volume. We're looking for a dedicated full-time editor to join us long term, not just to fill a seat.



For a sense of our team's production background, our founder previously built What's Up Metro Detroit 
 a local media brand that hit roughly 1 million views in its first four months. That's a different style and a different company, but it gives you a sense of the level we operate at.



The Role



You'll be editing short-form vertical video content for multiple clients every month. This is editing only, no scheduling, posting, or client communication required.



We're not looking for someone to just execute a checklist. We have a general house style (hooks, pacing, captions, branding) but we want to see your editing instincts and style, and we want you to help shape how our content evolves, not just replicate what we already do.



This is a quality-focused role, but quality and efficiency go hand in hand here. We need someone who can deliver genuinely good work at a pace that holds up across a full monthly client load.



Collaboration, Not Just Execution



This isn't a "deliverables in, deliverables out" position. We want a real creative collaborator: someone with opinions on shooting techniques, editing styles, pacing, trends, and content angles, and who actively brings ideas to the table as we grow. Your input matters to us.



For the right person, this can grow into a senior editor role overseeing other editors as we scale.



What We Need From You





Strong editing skills and a great eye for pacing, hooks, and short-form content that performs. We use CapCut, but Adobe Premiere or similar is fine, we'll provide a subscription to whichever tool we land on, no need to already own one

A willingness to bring your own ideas and opinions to the table on editing style, shooting techniques, and content strategy, not just execute instructions

A genuine commitment to quality, delivered efficiently across a full monthly workload

Strong, reliable communication, responsive during work hours and proactive about flagging issues

Comfortable with a high-output monthly schedule across multiple clients

Reliable internet and equipment for daily editing work





What We Offer





Stable, ongoing work (not project-based or one-off gigs), with hours growing toward a consistent 40/week as we add clients

A real voice in how we shoot, edit, and create, not just a list of instructions to follow

Long-term growth potential into a senior editor role leading a small team





How to Apply



Please apply with your resume and a portfolio of your previous editing work (short-form/social content preferred).



Important: Include the words "I am thorough" in the subject line of your application. Applications without this will not be reviewed.



After an initial interview, shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a short paid take-home test (editing one sample video two different ways) before a final decision is made.

title: Property Deal Analyst - Full Time
description:
We're a UK property company. We find rental property deals, analyse them, and either manage them ourselves or pass them to investors.



There's a steady flow of potential deals coming in every day, and someone needs to go through them properly and tell us which ones are worth our time.



It's careful, focused, repetitive work - and done well, it's one of the most important roles in the business, because everything we do starts with finding good deals and filtering out bad ones.



We're looking for someone who is genuinely good at careful, detailed analysis, takes pride in getting it right, and wants a stable role they can settle into for the long term.





Every day, you will:



Find potential deals :

Search specific
 groups and other online sources where property deals get posted.



Filter them (first pass):

Run each one against a clear set of pass/fail rules we'll give you. Most deals fail here - that's normal and correct. Your job is to kill the obvious "no" deals quickly so they never reach us.



Analyse the survivors (deep dive):

For the deals that pass the first filter, you'll do a proper analysis: pull the numbers, find comparable properties, check the competition, and fill out a deal analysis sheet we'll provide.



Give a verdict:

For each analysed deal, you'll give us a clear thumbs up or thumbs down - "this is a good deal" or "this isn't" - with your reasoning. We make the final call, but your verdict is what we act on, so it has to be sound.



Keep everything organised: 

Log each deal in our system so nothing slips through the cracks.



You will not be talking to landlords, negotiating, or closing deals. That's our side. Your job is the analysis and the verdict - and doing it accurately, every day, at good volume.





You'll do well here if you:



Can form a sound judgement on numbers. This is the heart of the job. You'll be d
 whether a deal is actually good, and we act on your verdict. 



We need someone who can look at the figures and think clearly about whether they really stack up - who can tell a genuinely good deal from one that's just been dressed up to look good. This is not copy-and-paste data entry.



Stay consistent, so deal number 40 gets the same care as deal number 1. You don't get sloppy when you're tired or bored. 



You hit your daily targets without being chased, and a cleared list done correctly gives you genuine satisfaction.



Catch the small things. A wrong comparable, a transposed number, a missing field - you notice it. In this work, small errors lead to wrong verdicts, so getting the details right the first time matters.



Want this role for the long term. You're looking for a stable, steady job you can hold for years - not a stepping stone to something else.



Have reliable power and internet. This work happens on a daily schedule, so you need a stable setup where you can work consistently without long outages.





Please don't apply if you:



Are looking for a short-term gig or a stepping stone while you pursue something else - studying full-time, planning to move abroad, building your own business on the side. This role needs your full focus and a long-term commitment.



Get bored easily by repetitive, detail-heavy work. This job is the same careful process every day. If that sounds dull to you, you'll be unhappy here and so will we.



You do not need any property or real estate experience - we'll train you on everything property-related. We're hiring for temperament and analytical ability, not property knowledge.





How to apply



There's a link below to complete the application form for this role. This is the only way your application will be processed.



You'll also need to attach a short Loom video of yourself within the application form, introducing yourself further. 



If you don't submit the Loom video, you will not be considered for this role



If the link below isn't clickable, just copy and paste it into your browser:

title: Full Time for Copywriter For Personal Brand
description:
# Instagram copywriter 



We're Digital Wealth Lab. We teach corporate people how to start AI marketing agencies for local businesses, and Bruno's Instagram is where most of that audience comes from. The account works because we skip the guru theater and just show the actual system. We need a writer who can keep it that way while we post more.



This is social copy. Not
, not landing pages, not blogs. If that's your portfolio you're probably great at it, but you're not who we're after. We want someone who has run an IG account for real: written the carousels and reels, watched what saved and what died, and figured out why.



## The job



Daily carousels for Bruno, reels later once you've got the voice down. You draft with our AI system to move fast, then rewrite it line by line until it's actually good. The AI gets you a draft. You write the post.



- Carousels now, reels soon, all in Bruno's voice

- Hooks that stop the scroll, CTAs that get DMs

- QA every post against the voice, the format specs, and our guidelines

- Brief the designers and editors so nobody's guessing

- Track what hits, what flops, what gets flagged, and fix the system off it

- Own the lead and growth numbers from organic



## Who we want



Not entry level. This is for someone already good at social who wants a bigger seat: real numbers, daily output, a small team, and a say in how the whole thing runs.



You should have:



- Written for influencers, coaches, or personal brands. Bonus if it's biz-op, finance, or self-improvement.

- Run an actual Instagram account day to day. Carousels, reels, captions, timing.

- Copy you'd defend. You can pull a reader from slide one to the CTA, and you know a good hook from a bad one without calling a meeting about it.

- A marketer's eye. Look at a post and tell us whether it's built to grow, to capture leads, or to sell.

- AI already in your workflow. You prompt Claude or GPT, you call out a weak draft, and you never ship the first thing it hands you.



Nice if you've got: theme page or shoutout experience, an info-product or high-ticket background, work for a 100k+ creator, funnels that turn attention into calls or sales, or ghostwriting in someone else's voice.



## Two things we won't budge on



The voice is Bruno's. If you'd rather write like yourself, you'll hate this.



Hours are 4 AM to 12 PM Eastern, Monday to Friday.



## How to apply



No test task, no consideration. Finish the whole thing and you'll hear back either way.



**1. Five-minute video.** Loom or whatever you've got. Who you are, why this role, why you, how you use AI, and anything you've written for creators or brands.



**2. The task.**



Part 1: Go through Bruno's profile (
), research the account, and pitch 5 post ideas (hook plus a short outline). No need to write the full posts.



Example:



> Hook: At 20 I was making $52k at a 9-5. I failed 6 businesses over the next 4 years. Everyone thought I was done. Then one boring AI tool changed everything.

>

> Outline: Bruno's story and the exact system he ran, with real numbers, named tools, and the math (what the tool costs vs. what the client pays).



Part 2: Write the full carousel for 2 of your 5 ideas. Draft with AI if you want, but we're paying for your writing, so the final words are yours. If you used AI, send the transcript too.



You get 24 to 48 hours once we send the task over.



Send us the video, your 5 ideas, the 2 carousels, and the transcript if there is one.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented, proactive, and mission-aligned Executive Assistant to directly support the CEO.



This role exists to protect the CEO's capacity for strategic work, including fundraising, partnerships, program expansion, and organizational growth. The Executive Assistant handles the administrative and operational infrastructure that keeps leadership moving efficiently while also serving as a key contributor to grant development and management in partnership with the organization's grant lead.



This is NOT an entry-level administrative position. We are seeking an experienced Executive Assistant who can confidently support executive leadership, manage competing priorities, exercise sound judgment, and operate independently in a fast-paced environment. While every organization has its own processes and systems, candidates should already possess strong Executive Assistant fundamentals and experience supporting senior leaders.



SCHEDULE



* Part-time position

* Monday through Friday

* 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM EST

* Opportunity for additional hours and expanded responsibilities as the organization grows



LEADING PEOPLE



You do not manage a team, but you represent the CEO's office in every interaction.



Your professionalism, responsiveness, discretion, and follow-through reflect directly on the organization's leadership. You will be trusted with sensitive information, key relationships, organizational priorities, and executive communications. This role requires maturity, professionalism, and a high level of integrity.



DELIVERING RESULTS



* CEO calendar is managed proactively with meetings scheduled, conflicts resolved, and preparation materials organized in advance.

* Follow-up items from CEO meetings are tracked, assigned, and completed without requiring the CEO to reinitiate action.

* CEO inbox is actively managed with communications sorted, prioritized, and monitored to ensure timely responses.

* Active partnerships, grants, and community relationships are maintained in a living tracking system with current status updates and next steps documented.

* Organizational priorities are coordinated across teams with the CEO informed and never surprised.

* Grant opportunities are researched and presented to leadership on a regular basis.

* Grant applications, proposals, Letters of Intent (LOIs), one-pagers, and supporting documentation are prepared, submitted, and maintained accurately and on time.

* Grant reporting requirements, compliance deadlines, and supporting records are maintained in an organized, audit-ready system.

* Leverages AI and automation tools appropriately to streamline administrative processes, improve efficiency, and reduce manual workload while maintaining accuracy and quality.

* Administrative burden on leadership is measurably reduced through strong ownership and execution.



COMMUNICATION



* Serve as the first point of contact for the CEO's office, including scheduling requests,
 communications, and external inquiries.

* Own the day-to-day management of the CEO's inbox, including prioritization, organization, drafting responses, and ensuring no communication falls through the cracks.

* Partner closely with the organization's grant lead to support grant writing coordination, deadlines, submissions, and documentation.

* Ensure internal teams receive clear communication regarding CEO priorities, decisions, and expectations.

* Handle sensitive communications with confidentiality and sound judgment.

* Document action items, commitments, and decisions from CEO meetings and ensure appropriate follow-up.



STRATEGIC THINKING



* Understand the CEO's priorities well enough to make informed decisions regarding scheduling, access, and time management.

* Anticipate needs before meetings, events, deadlines, and major initiatives.

* Monitor funding opportunities and trends relevant to the organization's mission and programs.

* Identify administrative inefficiencies and recommend practical solutions that improve organizational effectiveness.



ACCOUNTABILITY



* Provide weekly executive briefings that include calendar updates, open action items, grant deadlines, and partnership status reports.

* Ensure no grant deadline or compliance requirement is missed without advance notice and a documented plan.

* Maintain accurate and current records within all tracking and CRM systems.

* Ensure executive communications and follow-up expectations are consistently met.

* Protect CEO capacity by owning responsibilities that should not require executive involvement.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Minimum of 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Executive Coordinator, Project Coordinator, Administrative Operations Professional, or similar role.

* Demonstrated experience directly supporting senior executives, founders, CEOs, or C-suite leadership.

* Strong executive calendar management and inbox management experience.

* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, projects, and stakeholders simultaneously.

* Experience working in a fast-paced, mission-driven, nonprofit, startup, or growth-oriented environment.

* Strong organizational and project management skills.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

* Experience using project management, collaboration, and CRM systems.

* Comfortable working with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar platforms to support research, communication, organization, documentation, and administrative efficiency.

* High degree of discretion, trustworthiness, professionalism, and sound judgment.

* Strong alignment with the organization's mission of supporting underrepresented talent in technology.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Experience with grant research, grant writing, or nonprofit grant management.

* Familiarity with federal, state, corporate, and foundation funding opportunities.

* Experience coordinating cross-functional projects and organizational initiatives.

* Experience supporting a founder, CEO, or executive leadership team.

* Familiarity with HubSpot, Notion, Asana, Jira, Google Workspace, or similar platforms.



IMMEDIATE HIRE OPPORTUNITY



This is an immediate-hire opportunity for a candidate who can step into the role with confidence and professionalism. We are seeking someone who already understands the fundamentals of executive support and can quickly contribute to the success of the CEO and organization.



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered for this position, applicants must submit all of the following:



1. A current resume that includes complete employment history with start and end dates for each position.



2. A professional portfolio showcasing relevant work, accomplishments, projects, or case studies that demonstrate Executive Assistant, operations, project coordination, executive support, or organizational management experience.



3. A detailed introduction video that includes:



* Your Executive Assistant experience

* The executives or leaders you have supported

* Examples of complex responsibilities you have managed

* Why are you interested in this opportunity

* Why do you believe you are a strong fit for this role



4. Must use at least 10 apply points to be considered.



Applications that do not include all three required components will not be reviewed. Attention to detail is critical in this role, and complete application submissions are part of the evaluation process.

title: Performance Video Editor – Direct Response Ads
description:
PERFORMANCE VIDEO EDITOR – DIRECT RESPONSE ADS (Full-Time, Remote)



ABOUT US



We are LederKur — a fast-growing, six-figure German premium brand in the leather and wood care space. We sell direct-to-consumer through our own Shopify store and are scaling hard with Meta Ads as our main growth channel.



We are looking for a skilled and experienced Performance Video Editor who can take our scripts and turn them into scroll-stopping ad creatives that convert cold traffic into customers.



This is not a corporate video role. This is performance marketing. Every video you create has one job: make people stop scrolling, watch, and buy.





WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY



- Receive ready-made ad scripts from the founder

- Source all clips yourself (stock footage, UGC-style footage, AI-generated clips)

- Edit and deliver 20 to 25 finished ad creatives per week (mix of full edits from scratch and variations such as hook swaps, new intros, format changes, and CTA tests)

- Create different ad formats: UGC-style ads, talking head ads, VSLs (Video Sales Letters), native-style video ads

- Add captions, text overlays, transitions, and sound design

- Follow direct response best practices: strong hook in the first 2 seconds, pattern interrupts, fast pacing, clear CTAs

- Deliver final files optimized for Meta Ads (9:16, 1:1, 4:5)

- Iterate quickly when we give you feedback on what is working and what is not

- Build and maintain an organized clip library so you can move fast

- Test different hooks, openings, and visual styles based on performance data





WHAT YOU MUST HAVE



- Minimum 2 years of experience as a Performance Video Editor for DTC or e-commerce brands

- Expert-level video editing skills — use whatever software works best for you (CapCut, After Effects, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or anything else). We do not care which tools you use. We care about the output.

- A strong portfolio that shows real direct response ad creatives (not brand films, not corporate videos, not wedding edits — we need ads that were built to sell)

- IMPORTANT: All videos are in German. All captions, text overlays, and on-screen copy must be in German. You will receive all scripts and text in German — your job is to place them correctly and make sure there are zero spelling or formatting errors.

- Deep understanding of what makes an ad convert: hooks, pacing, retention, visual storytelling

- Ability to source clips on your own without being told exactly where to find them

- Consistent speed: 20 to 25 creatives per week (full edits and variations combined) is the standard, not the exception

- Reliable high-speed internet and your own editing setup (computer, software, storage)

- Good written communication in English

- Ownership mentality: you take full responsibility for your output quality and deadlines





NICE TO HAVE (Not Required)



- Understanding or speaking German — this is a big plus since all content is in German, but not a requirement. You will receive all text ready to use.

- Experience with AI video tools (Veo, Kling, Runway)

- Motion graphics and animation skills

- Experience editing ads for the German or European market

- Thumbnail and static image creation skills

- Basic understanding of Meta Ads performance metrics (CTR, hook rate, hold rate)





COMPENSATION



- $5 per hour USD (full-time, 40 hours per week)

- Full-time remote position

- Performance bonuses for creatives that hit strong results

- Long-term role with room to grow as the brand scales

- Salary increases based on performance reviews





WORK SETUP



- Fully remote — work from anywhere

- Full-time (40 hours per week)

- You must have overlap with European business hours (CET) for daily communication and feedback

- This is a fast-paced, high-output environment. We test constantly, iterate quickly, and move with urgency.

- You will communicate directly with the founder. No layers. No politics. Just clear direction and fast execution.





TOOLS WE USE



- Your editing software of choice — whatever makes you fastest and delivers the best output

- Google Drive (file sharing and delivery)

- Meta Ads Manager (for performance feedback and context)

- Shopify (our store — for product and brand context)





HOW TO APPLY



To apply, please send the following:



1. Your portfolio or showreel — must include direct response / performance ad creatives you have personally edited (not team projects, not brand films)

2. A short Loom video (2 to 3 minutes maximum) where you explain:

   - How long you have been editing performance ads

   - Your process when you receive a script: how do you go from script to finished creative?

   - One example from your portfolio: what was the goal, what did you do, what was the result?

3. Your expected hourly rate in USD

4. Your earliest available start date

5. Your current editing setup (computer specs, internet speed, software you own)





READ THIS CAREFULLY:



To confirm that you have read this entire job post from top to bottom, you MUST write our brand name in the FIRST LINE of your application message. If you do not know our brand name, you did not read the post. Applications without this will be ignored — no exceptions.





We are looking for one person. The right person. If that is you, we want to hear from you today.
